submitted.rationale: Index 20 (La0.52Sb0.48) has the highest measured EQE (0.0019%), though all three measurements are essentially zero. The ML models give most oxidized La–Sb ternaries (LaSbO4, La3SbO7, La2SbO6) band gaps above the 2.1 eV illumination. The candidates predicted to sit near 2.1 eV (La3Sb5O12 at idx 25, La3SbO3 at idx 12) gave no photoresponse. XRD matches to the reference phases were weak (all similarities below 0.3).

rejected.reason: Measured EQE of -0.0009%; the La3Sb5O12 hypothesis (2.26 eV gap) did not show a photoresponse
Measured EQE of -0.006%; the La3SbO3 hypothesis did not give a photoresponse
Predicted gap is about 0 eV (metallic), so it is unlikely to work as a photoanode

consultations.verdict: Support: La3Sb5O12 (Sb 0.625 ≈ idx 25) is on the MACE hull (0 eV/atom) and MEGNet HSE gap 2.26 eV, closest among oxidized stable ternaries to the 2.1 eV photon energy; the other oxidized ternaries (LaSbO4, La3SbO7) are ~4.3 eV. XRD match weak, so moderate confidence.

Support: La3SbO3 (Sb 0.25 ≈ idx 12) is on the MACE hull; MEGNet gap is 1.7 eV (SCAN) to 2.2 eV (HSE), which brackets the 2.1 eV illumination, so it could absorb. The Sb-rich La3Sb5O12 region (idx 25) gave ~0 EQE.

Mildly against: LaSbO4 (Sb 0.5, near idx 20) has a MEGNet SCAN gap of 2.65 eV, above the 2.1 eV photons. But both idx 25 and idx 12 gave ~0 EQE, and the GP puts its highest upper bound in the unexplored mid-line (19/20). I'm using the last measurement to explore there.
